lines:
Owns the driver-independent adashi-storage-api crate: ProjectStorage, StorageBackend, StorageClient, StorageFactory and consistent ReadSnapshot methods across every domain. Shared typed mutations/results, canonical document tokens, version/reference checks and durable fingerprinted receipts are used by desktop and MCP. ProjectStore selects and delegates to the complete SQLite adapter; no production connection escapes. LocalDerivedCache separates disposable health/preview data; waivers and legacy content remain canonical. QA reservation, atomic claim and evidence commits surround external process execution. Desktop narrow design edits preserve hierarchy/endpoints within the guarded transaction. Operation map and intentional API changes: docs/storage-api-migration.md.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): Extend the driver-independent storage-api crate and ProjectStore facade with Markdown artefact DTOs, typed save/delete mutations, inventory/summary queries, complete snapshot reads, canonical hashing/readTokens, scope/binding lookup, search, resource keys, typed references and backlinks. Use kind markdown and proposed DesignChange tags upsert_markdown/delete_markdown; keep existing generic documents envelope separate from MarkdownDesignDocument. Preserve existing atomic Mutation/CommitResult, idempotent receipts, unchanged-write semantics, reference validation and conflict rules. A changed title/body/designLinks invalidates the document token; unrelated edits and generated formatting do not. Shared tests must exercise every adapter implementation; no default trait stub that silently omits Markdown. ReadSnapshot remains immutable; storage drivers and connections never leak to MCP, desktop or projection. Migrate/transfer all canonical Markdown data and references; local generated manifests/caches are derived. Existing domains and historical data remain unchanged.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.

Text IDs and task communication numbers (2026-09-27; supersedes the 2026-09-25 sequential text-ID correction): Preserve existing permanent IDs and UUID references. Restore randomized numeric allocation for new text-backend records across all numeric collections; SQLite retains its own allocation policy. Detect genuine duplicate identities rather than silently redirect references. Task.number is a derived one-based position over all nondeleted project tasks ordered by created_at ascending, then permanent numeric id ascending. Compute it in shared storage queries before filtering/pagination; desktop and MCP consume the same value. Numbers may change after deletion or Git updates, never identify persisted links/history, and do not affect resource guards. MCP get accepts taskNumber as an alternative to taskId, optionally guarded by the observed project revision; subsequent mutations require the resolved permanent taskId and task version. Text format 3 omits task number from canonical records; versions 1/2 remain readable without writes and upgrade on successful writes. QA's stored number uses independent randomized allocation in text storage. Read-only opens preserve tracked bytes. Verify independent-clone memo/task/QA creation and merging, numbering/filter/page/get parity, stale number lookup, stable references and migration.
